authority_contract: Promote only exact source/runtime/domain/type/deployment semantics with executable binding, render, and refusal evidence. Otherwise emit no clear-signing leaf; the typed-data handler's mandatory descriptor proof then fails closed. EIP-712 quarantine never grants forced-blind authority.

reason_codes.missing-fixed-block-authority: Acquire a fixed-block/two-provider runtime receipt, proxy implementation evidence where applicable, pinned authoritative source/compiler/ABI, exact EIP-712 domain and type-hash derivation, and a real Merkle/binding/render transcript with negative mutations.
reason_codes.missing-offchain-verifier-authority: Identify and pin the authoritative verifier or protocol specification that consumes the exact type under the named domain and deployment; a fixture and parser support are insufficient.
reason_codes.deployment-domain-contradiction: Resolve the observed fixture/domain or source/deployment contradiction, then supply the complete fixed-block authority and transcript package.
reason_codes.wrong-deployment-binding: Replace the incorrect verifying-contract deployment with the authoritative verifier, prove it at a fixed block, and add a regression that the incorrect tuple remains refused.
reason_codes.presentation-correction-required: Correct the user-visible protocol or asset identity, then supply fixed-block deployment/type authority and exact transcript evidence.
reason_codes.resource-bound-unproven: Supply fixed-block deployment/type authority and prove useful accepted payload bounds plus fatal refusal at every page, array, and string boundary.
